verdict.rationale: Jan's own privacy posture keeps data away from model training in practice. It runs models entirely on the user's hardware, its privacy page says "Zero data collection until you say so" (collection is opt-in), and it advertises being "Privacy First" with everything running locally. However, no evidence explicitly says user data is never used for training, and its cloud integrations send data to third-party providers with no documented training opt-out controls. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment, documented controls or guidance on training use when cloud providers are connected, and independent verification of the zero-collection claim.
